description: This file defines the 'Template' controller class within the Opencart admin module, responsible for handling catalog template translation tasks such as listing templates, writing translations, and clearing generated translation files.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: Controller class handling catalog template translation operations in the admin panel of the Opencart system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a list of template file routes for translation tasks across stores and languages, scheduling translation write tasks.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes translations for a specific route, store, and language to a JSON file, creating directories as needed.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes generated translation files for all stores and languages, effectively clearing cached translation data.
